name: Letter to Stormpike
summary: In Southshore, Loremaster Dibbs entrusts you with an encrypted letter for Ironforge. He hopes Prospector Stormpike can read it.

sections.title: A Colleague in Ironforge
sections.body: Dibbs sends you to Ironforge to find Prospector Stormpike. He is in the Library, inside the Hall of Explorers. Tell him Dibbs sent you and show him the letter. Dibbs believes no one north of Blackrock Spire can read it better than Stormpike.

sections.title: Stormpike's Welcome
sections.body: When Stormpike learns Dibbs sent you, he asks how the old bookworm is doing. Encryption is his specialty, he says, then begins examining the letter.

faq.q: Who sends you to Ironforge with the letter?
faq.answer: Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore sends you to Ironforge with the letter. He hopes his colleague there can decrypt it.
Prospector Stormpike is in the Library, inside the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge.

faq.q: Why does Dibbs believe Stormpike can read the letter?
faq.answer: Dibbs believes Stormpike can read the letter if anyone north of Blackrock Spire can.
